resources.string: The account\'s songs are played by the app\'s own player instead of the hidden web page. Being tried: sorted lists play in their own order, and some controls may lag.
The Local Files row in your Library. Off: hidden; no file is touched.
Scan the code shown by your TV, computer or other phone: it gets your settings, extensions and sign-in.
Show a code for your phone to scan.
Scan this code with your phone
Point your phone\'s camera at it, or on the phone: Settings › Other devices › Send to another device. Both must be on the same Wi-Fi.
No Wi-Fi network: connect this device to the same Wi-Fi as your phone.
Your settings, extensions and Spotify sign-in are copied to this device, straight over your Wi-Fi and encrypted. Send them only to your own devices.
This is not a code of this app.
No code scanner on this phone (Google Play services).
Opened from a link. Send only if you just scanned this code on the screen of your own device.
Sign in on this phone first, then scan the code again.
What songs mean and the annotations on their lines, and Genius lyrics when no other source has them. Off: nothing is asked of Genius.
You sign in next, on Spotify\'s own page. Jam never sees your password.
Show a code that your phone scans to get this sign-in, your settings and extensions.
Scan this code with Jam on your phone
On your phone, in Jam: on Spotify\'s sign-in page tap Trouble signing in? › Sign in with your computer (or Welcome › Sign in with your computer), then scan this code. Both must be on the same Wi-Fi.
Sign in to Spotify in Jam on your computer, show its code (Settings › Other devices › Sign in another device), and scan it here.
Jam gets the Spotify sign-in, settings and extensions of that device, straight over your Wi-Fi and encrypted. Then it starts again.
This is the code for sending, not for signing in. On the computer use Settings › Other devices › Sign in another device.
Sign in with a session code
Spotify\'s session code (the sp_dc cookie) from a computer where you\'re signed in: no sign-in page on this phone at all.

1. On a computer, sign in at open.spotify.com (Chrome, Edge or Firefox).
2. Press F12 › Application (Firefox: Storage) › Cookies › https://open.spotify.com.
3. Copy the value of sp_dc and send it to this phone (an email or a note to yourself).
 Or in Jam for Windows: Settings › Other devices › Sign in another device › Copy the session code.
4. Paste it here.
That doesn\'t look like an sp_dc value. Copy the whole value (a long string of letters, digits, - and _).
Keep this code private: it signs anyone in as you, like a password. Signing out of Spotify everywhere makes it stop working.
Session code copied. Paste it on your phone: Trouble signing in? › Sign in with a session code. Keep it private.
No Spotify session here yet: sign in to Spotify first.
